name: Space station
about: Deck 7 of an orbital station. A planet turns in the viewport, the station AI reads the comms, the core charges as you focus.
backdrop: radial-gradient(1px 1px at 12% 20%, #fff, transparent), radial-gradient(1px 1px at 70% 10%, #fff, transparent), radial-gradient(1px 1px at 40% 80%, #cde, transparent), radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 85% 60%, #fff, transparent), radial-gradient(1px 1px at 25% 55%, #bcd, transparent), radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 40% at 50% 120%, rgba(40,120,255,.22), transparent 70%), #04070d

words.note: Send a message to Station AI.

names: the stars are not in a hurry
gags: The engineer taped a note to the airlock: 'spaced repetition is not a docking procedure.'
runs a diagnostic on you. Result: needs one more focus block, and water.
Someone floated a flashcard past the viewport. It's still orbiting.
Comms picked up the same faint signal for three nights. It's lo-fi. Nobody minds.
A sticker on the console: 'In space, no one can hear you reread.'
reminds you that a day here is 90 minutes long. Plenty of time for a block, it says.

lines.play: A play block. The engineer powers down the drills. Fun is on the mission plan.
lines.evening: Evening shift. The deck fills up around now. Nobody else up here brought homework.
lines.friday: Friday night, and you're studying in orbit. The crew respects it. Quietly.
lines.silent: No grading for {days} days. Station AI is counting stars to pass the time.
lines.newyear: New year. Same orbit. The core doesn't discharge.
lines.nye: Last shift of the year. Charge the core, not just the clock.
lines.halloween: Halloween. The engineer says the noise in the vents is the station settling. Sure.
lines.valentine: Valentine's Day. Two crew members share a viewport. Attention, as they say, is all you need.
lines.music_quiet: Comms are quiet. Press play, or listen to the hum of the station.

lines.day: Shift complete. Another patch for the wall.
lines.week: Week goal met. Station AI is pinning a medal on you. Hold still.
lines.die: A core, fully charged. It's in the cargo bay now.
lines.gift: Station AI left something in the cargo bay.
